period_note:
Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/Standalone basis, matching this dataset's main Q4/annual series basis (see sources.json reporting_basis).  Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (Jan-1 through the end of this quarter), not discrete-quarter figures, per this project's convention (flagged via the _cumulative suffix, matching bank_financials/CITYBANK/quarterly/2024_Q1.json). Shariah-based Islamic bank: 'Investments' is the Shariah-compliant equivalent of conventional Loans and Advances; 'Profit paid on Deposits' is the equivalent of Interest Expense; 'Net Investment Income' is the equivalent of Net Interest Income -- consistent with the convention already used for this bank's Q4/annual series. Classified-investment (asset-quality/NPL) and Capital Adequacy (CRAR/Tier-1/Tier-2) figures are NOT disclosed in SIBL's interim quarterly/half-yearly filings at all (confirmed absent from every quarter's notes checked in this pass) -- this is a genuine limitation of the source documents themselves, not an extraction gap, so no classified_investments/npl_pct/car_pct/tier1/tier2/RWA fields are populated for any Q1-Q3 period in this dataset.

POST-GENERATION CORRECTION NOTE: several income-statement sub-line-items in this quarter's source page had systematic extraction defects (font/character corruption, dropped leading digits, or a wrong-column/wrong-row value) that were not caught by the balance-sheet-identity check alone. These were found and corrected using a second-pass internal-consistency audit (checking that Net Investment Income + Income from Shares + Commission + Other Operating Income sums to Total Operating Income, and that Total Operating Income minus Expenses minus Provision minus Tax chains correctly to Net Profit After Tax) before this file was finalized; corrected/added fields carry their own metric_note explaining the specific fix. Values that could not be reconstructed with confidence were omitted rather than guessed.
